tested_scope: One deterministic self-local model/replay of the open continuation from the prior checkpoint. Current authority remains F10 and the finalization slot keyed by {O5,D5,I7} starts ABSENT. Two same-F10 writers are interleaved through one atomic predicate. Variant A uses identical full records; Variant B uses conflicting full records. This tests only repository-finalization claim/idempotency semantics and the minimum atomic compare set. It does not execute real concurrent GitHub writes, test an external side effect, a concrete provider, public sources, hosted coordination, richer-mode arbitration, O/downstream/other-worker state, scheduler state, or a second semantic leaf.

fixture.atomic_predicate: Commit candidate C only if current_claim_fence == C.fence AND finalization_slot == ABSENT in the same atomic compare-and-set; write digest(C.full_record) as the slot value. On retry, require current_claim_fence == C.fence; exact slot digest equality => idempotent no-op, nonempty unequal digest => conflict/no effect.

variant_identical_writers.interleaving_result: Exactly one writer may perform ABSENT->digest(R10). The loser cannot also satisfy ABSENT; after reread under still-current F10 it sees exact digest equality and is classified as idempotent no-op.

variant_conflicting_writers.interleaving_result: Exactly one candidate may win the initial ABSENT transition. The losing candidate sees a nonempty unequal slot digest and must fail closed as conflict/no effect; same operation/idempotency identity and same fence do not establish replay equivalence.

minimum_atomic_fields.why: If the fence is read outside the atomic mutation, a fence advance can race the slot write and admit a stale finalization. If the slot only records occupancy or operation/fence identity, a conflicting same-F10 candidate can be misclassified as a harmless retry.

weak_rules_falsified: W30: fence equality plus an initially observed ABSENT slot is sufficient even when those checks are not atomic.
W31: after one writer commits, any loser with the same operation/idempotency identity and F10 can be treated as a no-op regardless of full-record digest.

observations: In the deterministic identical-writer interleaving, the atomic ABSENT transition admits one winner and converts the loser to exact-record replay/no-op.
In the deterministic conflicting-writer interleaving, the same atomic transition admits one winner and forces the unequal loser to conflict/no effect.
The fence and slot state/digest must participate in one atomic repository predicate; checking either one separately leaves a race window.
inference: Within this modeled repository-finalization scope, monotonic fencing plus a per-operation exact-record slot is sufficient to make same-fence retry classification duplicate-safe under two-writer contention, provided fence and slot are compared atomically. This remains a model/replay result and does not prove exactly-once behavior for external effects outside the repository mutation.
unresolved_children: Test the same two-writer fixture after a fence advance to F11: an exact historical R10 digest must no longer authorize replay despite record equality.
